statement: TSMC CoWoS advanced-packaging lead times are reported at roughly 52-78 weeks, beyond twelve months.
why: Advanced packaging sits upstream of every high-end accelerator, so a year-plus lead time sets the floor on how fast new GPU supply can reach buyers.

impact.mechanism: Orders placed today for CoWoS capacity do not yield packaged parts for a year or more, capping near-term accelerator output regardless of order book strength.

evidence.excerpt: TSMC CoWoS lead time -- now ~52-78 weeks (beyond 12 months)

confidence.basis: Secondary newsletter aggregating third-party sources; no foundry disclosure read, and the figure is given as a wide range rather than a point value.

dispersion: Reported as a range of ~52-78 weeks; no single point value stated, so no measured number is recorded.
